# successor organization

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:successorOrganization`](gmeow-successorOrganization.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/successorOrganization>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An organization that begins or results from a multi-organization change event. Non-functional: a split has several successors, and competing standpoint-indexed successor claims coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:successorOrganization`](gmeow-successorOrganization.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a multi-organization change [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to name an organization that began or resulted from it — the surviving merged entity, a spun-off division, a renamed body.

### Avoid when

- Avoid a direct organization-to-organization edge (the change is mediated by an [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)) and avoid forcing one successor — a split has several, and competing succession claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), never a preferredSuccessor.

### How to use

- Reify the change as a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) and attach each resulting organization with [`gmeow:successorOrganization`](gmeow-successorOrganization.md), pairing with [`gmeow:predecessorOrganization`](gmeow-predecessorOrganization.md); carry contested claims with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md).

### Examples

- ex:merger [`gmeow:successorOrganization`](gmeow-successorOrganization.md) ex:newco.
